550482a44917d6af.title: ho99o9, N8 NoFace, slay squad
550482a44917d6af.desc: Ho99o9 (pronounced Horror) is an American punk rap duo founded in 2012 in Newark, New Jersey, by theOGM and Yeti Bones (also known as Eaddy). They have released multiple EPs, accompanied by grindhouse-style music videos, and three full-length albums, United States of Horror (2017), SKIN (2022) and Tomorrow We Escape (2025). N8NOFACE is a Tucson, Arizona--raised musician and rapper now based in Long Beach, California, known for blending gritty punk with lo‑fi hip‑hop into a dark, personal, and often surreal sound Slay Squad formed in 2013, initially starting as a hip-hop group before evolving into a rap metal collective. Their music blends rap, metal, and hip-hop, a style they describe as "ghetto metal," reflecting both aggressive energy and underground influences.

55050ac1f3a0bbf8.title: Phoebe Bridgers: The Lost Tour
55050ac1f3a0bbf8.desc: Don’t let the somber tone of her music fool you: the Los Angeles-based singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers has a sunny disposition. “I’d hate for someone to think I’m sipping an espresso somewhere judging people or feeling sorry for myself. OK, I definitely do that once in a while, but I don’t consider myself an intense person.” Bridgers grew up in the rose-colored city of Pasadena, attending the prestigious Los Angeles County High School for the Arts to study music. From an early age, she found encouragement from a close-knit artistic community of friends and family to follow her dreams, and at school she forged relationships that would teach her as much about her craft as her classes. “I think most of my musical education had to do with being around a ton of teenagers who listened to music all the time,” she says. “At school I had classical training for my voice, but I think being surrounded by people who were really enthusiastic about art and going to concerts all the time was the real education.” “I met Carla Azar of Autolux – and she showed me Elliott Smith for the first time, which was my first personal connection to music that one of my parents hadn’t showed me,” she says.…

55c9bc5df97dcb56.title: Divorce Care Higher Vision Church
55c9bc5df97dcb56.desc: No matter how amiable, separation or divorce is one of the most painful experiences. But you are not alone: there is a DivorceCare support group for people walking through separation or divorce. DivorceCare is a safe, welcoming place where people understand the difficult emotions and challenges of separation and divorce. Over 13 weeks, you’ll find relief and comfort as you learn what to expect in the days ahead and how to navigate your personal healing journey. Since separation and divorce can be messy and confusing, you’ll learn helpful ways of coping with the challenges and navigating relationships—and gain solid support each step of the way. Topics include how to manage divorce-related emotions such as loneliness, anxiety, bitterness, anger, and grief; how to cope with the changes in your life and relationships; the importance of forgiveness; and how to navigate legal and financial issues. At a weekly DivorceCare meeting, you will view a video featuring respected counselors, teachers, and healthcare professionals on divorce and recovery topics. After that is a small group discussion for sharing, support, and personal application of what you learned on the video. You will…
